checks.detail: List/audit initial states use local loading presentations; drawer provides a named busy status and skeleton when actually loading. Entries/audit use loading text, not table-shaped skeletons. Disabled or paused detail reads are separately failing under drawer-trust.
Only list/audit fatal errors replace their own data content; retry and neighboring panel shells remain.

Disabled, failed and paused detail reads can present unavailable payloads as measured binary data; detail retry/error/trust is not wired.
Arrays/nullable metadata and invalid byte sizes are guarded for the actual handler's object-array shape. This is not a malformed arbitrary JSON fuzz pass; full DTO alignment fails separately.

TextDecoder fatal mode and React text rendering avoid interpreting opaque bytes as markup; real binary copy falls back to base64. Missing/empty payload and tab-panel relationships are incorrect. No actual payload was decoded, copied, downloaded or captured.

Existing loaded-row search/value filters and 25/50/100 pagination remain. Filtering to zero rows incorrectly reuses authoritative-empty claims. Global audit fetch is latest 50, not full-history paging.

Replay requires explicit confirmation; busy confirmation cannot be canceled, buttons disable, drawer closes only on result=ok, confirmation clears in finally, 403 uses a warning, sudo cancellation is silent and other failures use a toast. Current server sends non-ok domain outcomes with non-2xx statuses. Live-only/offline guards precede network. No replay or authentication flow executed.

All five hook path patterns match the mounted GET/POST routes; query parameter is limit. No double prefix or camelCase query-parameter matches in the scoped scan. This does not make string ID semantics correct.

Opaque ring IDs are strings, not numbers. Omitted detail/audit fields are typed as required strings and JSON audit payload is typed as string rather than JSON. Numeric database audit-row IDs remain distinct from ring IDs.

Literal scan checked 98 calls: one missing key and one fallback mismatch. Additional manual inspection proves both replay toast keys are absent from canonical admin.dlq. Labels generally use localization; machine reason/result strings remain verbatim source data, not proof of localized human outcome descriptions.
Inspect buttons have row-specific names, loading has status/busy labels and reason bars include text. Tab aria-controls IDs reference no consumer panel IDs.
Audit mobile allow-list hides four fields without a row detail action/mobile adapter. Entries have an Inspect recovery surface, but its opaque-ID detail read is broken.

Byte counts/counts/statuses are not vehicle measurement conversions. Opaque payloads are not unit-converted; hooks preserve raw response data and AbortSignal. No page RUM bootstrap, deprecated converter or ad-hoc source fetch was introduced or present in the inspected page.

confirmedFindings.mechanism: Handler emits a 32-character hex string ID. request() only recases JSON keys; it does not convert values. useDLQEntry requires typeof id=number, replaces the real string with 0 and disables fetching. Scoped audit similarly routes a string ID to the global feed. Related DTOs incorrectly declare replayed_id/dlq_id numeric.
confirmedFindings.repro: Source-trace only: take any synthetic backend-shaped string ID, select its summary row, follow page selected.id into useDLQEntry. The number guard is false, enabled=false and there is no detail GET. No live ID or request is necessary.

Add source-realistic string-ID regressions in a separately assigned fix.
